Paint all previously unseen far heel, arch, sidewall and sole continuously and anatomically, in the same muted burgundy palette and broad asymmetric dry-brush style. The shoe must remain a complete real painted volume when later exposed in front of the other leg; a floating upper toe or dark sole rectangle is insufficient. The entire shoe outline, including back of heel and underside, is visible on transparency. Keep every ankle/strap/instep/sole junction attached. These are source layers for a connected walking rig, not a finished new standing character. Preserve the original source character's mature painterly Disco Elysium/Berlin treatment. Actual clean alpha, no red/green matte outlines.
